summary: Backend-only regression + new Google-auth/sync tests for Navigatore Sanitario. 22/22 tests passed (pytest, run via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Verified: (1) /api/auth/session rejects invalid session_id with 401 'session_id non valido o scaduto', rejects missing field with 422, rejects empty string with 400 'session_id mancante'; (2) /api/auth/me returns 401 (not 403) when Authorization header is missing (uses manual Header, not HTTPAuthorizationCredentials) and 401 'Sessione non valida' for a bogus Bearer token; (3) /api/auth/logout is idempotent (200 {ok: true}) without a token and correctly deletes a real session token, after which /me returns 401 and the session doc is gone; (4) /api/sync/upload and /api/sync/download both 401 without token; (5) Startup indexes verified directly on MongoDB (test_database): users has unique indexes on email and user_id, user_sessions has unique index on session_token plus TTL index on expires_at with expireAfterSeconds=0, user_data has unique index on user_id; (6) End-to-end with a mock session injected in Mongo works: /auth/me returns the user, /sync/upload accepts payload, /sync/download returns exactly what was uploaded (reports, checklist, region); (7) Expired session returns 401 'Sessione scaduta'; (8) Regression: /api/reports create returns shareToken, /api/reports/share/{token} returns the report (no _id leak), /api/reports/device/{id} returns {items:[...]} with no _id, unknown shareToken 404s; (9) /api/assistant returns a non-empty answer via Emergent LLM key and 400 on empty question.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user correctly uses fastapi.Header(Optional[str]) so a missing Authorization header returns 401 as required (not 403 which HTTPBearer would have produced).

TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at uses expireAfterSeconds=0, so documents auto-expire once expires_at passes - good. Note: TTL sweeper runs ~every 60s in Mongo, so briefly-expired sessions are still handled by the explicit check in get_current_user (verified).

auth_session upserts by session_token; if the Emergent auth service ever returns the same session_token for two different users this would silently rebind - unlikely but worth an explicit assertion in the future.
/api/sync/upload silently truncates reports to first 50 items with no warning to caller; consider returning the accepted count so the client can detect truncation.
seed_data_creation: Test-only Mongo rows in users/user_sessions/user_data prefixed with 'user_TEST_' / 'TEST_tok_' and reports prefixed with 'TEST_r_' - all cleaned up in fixture teardown. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To simulate an authenticated user without a real Google OAuth flow, insert directly into MongoDB (mongodb://localhost:27017 db=test_database): a users doc with user_id/email and a user_sessions doc with matching user_id + session_token + expires_at in the future, then call APIs with Authorization: Bearer <session_token>. Full pattern is in backend_test.py::TestAuthenticatedE2E. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is used as public base URL for tests.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All 22 tests passed on the first run.
